what: Replaces an element’s CSS border with a hand-drawn loop of the same color and weight — 8 evenodd SVG paths are pre-drawn, with outer and inner edges wobbled separately by 36px-grain noise (weight also swells ±15%), and cycled 8 times per second. Panels over 200px get .5% thicker for each excess amount. Pauses when off-screen, on phones or with reduced motion it stops on the first frame

options.fps: Frames per second, default 8 — 0 means a single still frame
options.seed: Seed — lock it if you need the same Type

note: Border color follows CSS border-color as is (write a skin variable and it follows the skin). The original hangs it on an empty panel laid over the photo (negative inset)
